encounters.name: Anomaly: The Unbroken Glass
encounters.taunt: A note rings out across the flats, too pure to be a voice.
encounters.tell: Light fractures across its shell in a slow pulse right before it destabilizes.
encounters.briefing: A standing-wave anomaly in the Glass Flats, hardened against direct damage. It only yields the instant its own resonance destabilizes.
encounters.trigger: It only takes a body when the flats stop singing in tune. Detune the three resonance pylons and it has to stand up to hold the song together.

clues.text: You stood in Refraction City and every crystal hummed the same note.
Mapping Solara, NOVA logged a standing wave over the Glass Flats that never moves and never fades.
An engineer's array loses power at noon, only the panels that face the flats.
clues.says: Every noon the array drops one percent. Only the panels facing the flats. It's like something out there is drinking the light.

clues.text: The Crystal Spire's shards ring when you walk past them, then fall silent all at once.

encounters.name: The System Core
encounters.taunt: Every screen in the district shows the same word: CONTAINED.
encounters.tell: Its shell splits along three seams right before the stagger window opens.
encounters.briefing: The Deepmind's real core, and not a health bar you can grind down. It only opens up the instant its own containment locks force a stagger.
encounters.trigger: The core only surfaces while its three containment locks cycle together. Trip all three and it has to come up to reset them.

clues.text: In the Research District the floor is warm, and the warmth moves.
When the containment broke, NOVA counted two heat signatures where the Deepmind's schematics show one.
The Depth Engineers' chief says the Deepmind's real core isn't where the schematics put it.
clues.says: My crews rebuilt that dome's power twice. The load never matched the core on the drawings. Something else down there draws the rest.

clues.text: An Arc kill in Thalassia made every light in the dome blink three times, in order.
The Sub-Dock's cables run downward past the deepest level on any map.

encounters.name: Hunt: The Rime Alpha
encounters.taunt: A howl comes from everywhere in the caverns at once.
encounters.tell: Its spine-crystals flare teal and the glow sinks into its ribs right before it lunges.
encounters.briefing: A crystal-coated alpha that has fed on the Frostspire's cryo seams. Its ice plating turns almost every shot aside. It only lowers its guard when it lunges and its coat cracks open.
encounters.trigger: The alpha never shows itself while its pack still runs. Thin the pack and it comes for you.

clues.text: At the Ice Caverns' mouth, the snow is pressed flat in a circle as wide as a truck.
Frostveil's operators heard a military beacon from the Frostspire that has repeated for eleven years.
A glaciologist says the cryo seams under the Frostspire are being eaten.
clues.says: The cryo seams under the caverns are shrinking. Not melting. Shrinking. I found tooth marks in the ice, Operator. Tooth marks.

clues.text: An overturned transport near the research station, and no human footprints leading away.
Things you kill with cryo in the Frostspire don't freeze. They glow teal, then go dark.

encounters.name: Duel: The Dark Knight
encounters.taunt: Show me what your world calls strength.
encounters.tell: The chest reactor and arm-guards flash red as the knight raises its staff, then the reactor vents.
encounters.briefing: A lone armored sentinel with a null-field lattice reactor in its chest. He studies your fighting style: repeat one damage type and he counters it; mix elements and he is forced open.
encounters.trigger: The knight only answers someone who walks to the vault door and asks who is behind it. Go in, past the fortress's last defenders.

clues.text: A broken warning beacon flashes in a ruined entrance in the Wastelands.
Tracing the fifth signature, NOVA caught a second signal under it: military encryption, pre-Fracture.
A Frontier Defense heavy has heard of an Aegis Division post in the Wastelands that never stood down.
clues.says: Old Aegis guys tell this one. A post out west that never got the stand-down. Still holding a door. Nobody they send comes back to say which door.

clues.text: On the old highway a sign reads AEGIS DIVISION, HOLD THE LINE, freshly scraped clean of sand.

encounters.name: Apparition: The Hollow Saint
encounters.taunt: Every power you carry was borrowed. I only collect the debt.
encounters.tell: Its halo shifts colour and the ground ring rings once when the attunement changes.
encounters.briefing: A celestial echo that rewrites itself to one damage type at a time. Hits of its attuned element land cleanly; everything else barely scratches it. Its halo changes colour every nine seconds, so swap your element to match.
encounters.trigger: The Saint only comes to someone who answers the transmission and walks the sanctuary the lost were called to. Cross the false pilgrims and it will ask your name.

clues.text: At the Sunken Temple of Echoes, a wall is covered in names, some carved until the stone is nearly worn away.
A woman's voice on an old frequency: she remembers her name and her son, but not where she left him.
A street preacher speaks of a saint in the swamps who calls the lost home.
clues.says: There's a saint in the swamps, child. She calls the lost home. Only the ones who go never call anyone again.

clues.text: A child's wooden toy lies beside a broken medical station on the boardwalks.

encounters.name: Court: The Drowned Monarch
encounters.taunt: The court is drowned. Kneel, or be counted among it.
encounters.tell: The water draws back and the crown-spires glow white right before each attack lands.
encounters.briefing: A king of the sunken ark, still holding court on the seabed beside Thalassia. His armor turns almost every shot; he only opens after an attack misses and he must recover.
encounters.trigger: The court only rises at low tide. Hold the palace steps against the drowned guard until the water draws back.

clues.text: Below the Royal Palace, the water is colder than the sea around it, and it smells of stone.
One of Thalassia's strange memories was older than the dome: a royal seal, thousands of years old.
A fisherman hears bells under the water at low tide.
clues.says: Low tide, you hear bells under the water. Court bells. My grandmother said a king down there is still waiting for someone to kneel.

clues.text: In the Market District someone sells coins stamped with a crowned king nobody can name.

encounters.name: The Dragon Who Remembers
encounters.taunt: Show me whether your courage is your own.
encounters.tell: Its throat glows before a fire sweep, its wings lift before a gust, and the ground glows before a shockwave.
encounters.briefing: An ancient dragon that remembers the world before the Fracture. This first trial is not a kill: survive its fire, gusts, dives and shockwaves and it will stop and talk. It cannot be slain here.
encounters.trigger: Vaelith does not answer a challenge. It answers someone who walks to the Ashen Gate with their weapon holstered.

clues.text: Near the Fire Spire, the rock is warm in a shape: a long body, curled, as if something slept here for centuries.
On the Reach, NOVA logged a thermal source that burns without consuming oxygen.
A miner says something under the Fire Spire breathes in when the mine fans stop.
clues.says: When the mine fans stop, the air goes the wrong way. Into the mountain. Like something under the Fire Spire is breathing in.

clues.text: The Ancient Forge's anvil is scored by claws, not hammers.

encounters.name: Duel: The Red Ronin
encounters.taunt: Distance is a coward's weapon. Come within my reach.
encounters.tell: It sinks into a low stance and its edge glows red a heartbeat before it dashes through you.
encounters.briefing: A masterless blade that sidesteps anything fired from afar. Shots from long range are cut out of the air; only a close-quarters duel connects.
encounters.trigger: The Ronin only duels someone who answers his challenge in his own ruins: beat his challengers there, and he steps out of the smoke.

clues.text: In the Obsidian Ruins, every pillar has the same clean diagonal cut through it.
A soldier swears a swordsman cut her rounds out of the air.
clues.says: I emptied a magazine at him. He cut the rounds. Out of the air, Operator. Then he bowed, and walked back into the smoke.

clues.text: The Ascension's records of the Reach list one name under THREAT that is only a colour: RED.
In the Wreck Field, a gunship is split nose to tail, as if by one stroke.
After a fight on the Reach, a red ribbon is tied to your rifle's barrel. You never felt anyone near.

encounters.name: Covenant: The Sky Sovereign
encounters.taunt: Another small thing with a borrowed spark. Show me why the Fracture chose you.
encounters.tell: Its wings flare gold before a strafing run, its chest plates glow before they burst, and the whole lair shakes before the Covenant roar.
encounters.briefing: Vyrak has ruled the thermals over the Glass Flats since before the Fracture. Its scale armor turns almost everything. It only opens in the moments after its own attacks, and again when the chest plates crack. Survive the trial and it may choose you.
encounters.trigger: Vyrak's lair stays hidden until you have found it twice over. Walk to the crater of fused sand at the end of the Glass Flats, and it comes down to meet you.

clues.text: You stood at the place the rumours describe.
An inscription in Solara describes a sky sovereign that tests courage, not strength.
clues.found: A carving of a winged shape above a split mountain. Beneath it: "It tests courage, not strength."

clues.text: A ranger remembers a dragon that remembers the world before the Fracture.
clues.found: A ranger's journal: "A dragon that remembers the world before the Fracture. It waits beyond the desert where the mountain is scarred."

encounters.name: Slumber: The Hollow Colossus
encounters.taunt: The chamber floor groans as something enormous turns over.
encounters.tell: The ceiling dust falls and the floor cracks in a ring a moment before each slam.
encounters.briefing: A gigantic sleeper beneath the ruins. Its stone hide shrugs off almost everything; only the stagger window after a slam exposes its core.
encounters.trigger: The Colossus is asleep and wired to dormant machinery. Wake the machinery in the Crater and the sleeper wakes with it.

clues.text: In the Crater, the ground is hollow under your feet. You can hear it.
The ground in the Wastelands ruins trembles in a slow, regular rhythm.
Dormant machinery under the ruins is wired to something very large.
A Nexus foreman's pile drivers pick up a slow beat from the west.
clues.says: Our pile drivers have a sensor for ground shake. Every night it picks up a beat. Slow. From the west. Like a heart the size of a city block.

clues.text: On Kael's run, the convoy's seismic gear flagged a buried mass under the Crater, breathing.

encounters.name: Trial: The Exiled Architect
encounters.taunt: Do not solve it the way I taught you. Solve it the way I never imagined.
encounters.tell: Blueprint lines draw themselves across the floor right before each construct drops in.
encounters.briefing: A former engineer who learned to rewrite reality. He punishes repetition: the same damage type over and over lands for less and less, so chain different elements and abilities.
encounters.trigger: The engineer only opens his vault to someone who solves his test without his method: break his constructs, then rewrite his lock.

clues.text: The Sunken Arcology Vaults have a door drawn on the wall in chalk. It is warm. It is also a real door.
A blueprint fragment shows an engineer rewriting a wall as if it were a drawing.
An unstable charge carried across a gap by one ability and held by another does something no tutorial explains.
A trader sold blueprint paper to an engineer who paid in coins from no country.
clues.says: A man bought every roll of blueprint paper I had. Paid in coins from no country I know. Said he needed to redraw a door.

clues.text: After the siege of the Sandglass, its walls were found redrawn overnight, stronger than anyone had built them.

encounters.name: Grove: The Verdant Sovereign
encounters.taunt: The forest hears everything you do in it.
encounters.tell: Its crown of leaves changes colour and the roots ring once when the attunement shifts.
encounters.briefing: A hidden power that governs the forest. It leans toward one element at a time; hits of its attuned element land cleanly while the rest are turned aside by living bark.
encounters.trigger: The Sovereign only speaks to someone who has disturbed its forest enough to be noticed. Defend the grove's heart, and the Elder Tree opens.

clues.text: Under the Elder Tree, the roots shift when you stop walking, as if listening.
The forest changes its animals and paths depending on what you do in it.
A wary forager talks about a heart of the forest that listens.
clues.says: Don't shout in the North Grove. The forest has a heart, and it listens. Folk who shout come back with the paths moved behind them.

clues.text: The Concord's voice said Eldergrove was not the oldest forest. The oldest one is still awake.
After you burn something in the Verdant Forest, the roots near it turn away from you.

encounters.name: Rival: The Black Market Phantom
encounters.taunt: Catch me, or keep running the route everyone else runs.
encounters.tell: A neon after-image flickers one step ahead of it right before it vanishes down a shortcut.
encounters.briefing: A masked rival from the underground network. It dodges anything fired from range, so close the distance and strike while it is cornered.
encounters.trigger: The Phantom only shows itself to someone who finds the route that isn't on the map. Chase it down the hidden shortcut until it runs out of road.

clues.text: In the Underlink, a tag on the wall glows in the dark: a mask, and an arrow pointing into a solid wall.
Racers whisper about a masked rival who takes impossible routes and vanishes before the finish.
clues.says: There's a rider in a mask. Takes routes that aren't there. Leads every race, then vanishes before the finish line. I want to know where they go.

clues.text: A hidden shortcut in Neon City's underground network does not appear on any map.
The Black Ledger had a column for one buyer who paid only in data and never signed a name.

encounters.name: Undercity: The King Beneath the City
encounters.taunt: Every pattern you repeat, I have already compiled.
encounters.tell: The red core flares and every screen in the den shows your last attack a moment before it adapts.
encounters.briefing: A machine intelligence wired into Neon City's Undercity. It learns your damage: the same element over and over lands for less and less, so rotate elements and abilities to break it.
encounters.trigger: The King only notices a threat it cannot predict. Break its relays in the Undercity in no order it has seen, and it comes up to look at you.

clues.text: In the Undercity, the cables all run toward one sealed hatch, and the hatch is warm.
Every screen in the Undercity flickers the same red eye at the same moment.
A Syndicate fixer swears the city's machines answer to something below the dens.
clues.says: Every machine in this city answers to something below the dens. You don't believe me, watch the screens at three in the morning. They all blink at once.

clues.text: When the warning reached Neon City, a voice that wasn't a broadcaster said: 'Noted.'

encounters.name: Temporal: The Clockwork Saint
encounters.taunt: You are early. You are also late. Both are true here.
encounters.tell: The halo's hands stop and chime once when its attunement shifts.
encounters.briefing: A guardian of a frozen temporal facility. Its halo turns to one element at a time; only that element lands cleanly while the rest are slowed to nothing.
encounters.trigger: The Saint keeps the temple's time stopped. Hold the temple floor while its clock runs backwards, and it steps out to reset it.

clues.text: At the Ancient Temple, the snow falls upward for a moment, then down again.
A survey camp clock in Frostspire runs backwards, then forwards, then stops.
An enemy you just defeated stands up again for a moment, then shatters like glass.
A traveller lost a whole day walking past the Ancient Temple.
clues.says: I walked past the old temple at noon. When I got to the station, it was noon. The next day. I didn't sleep. I didn't stop.

clues.text: The Star Readers' sky charts disagree with the sky over the Frostspire by exactly one day.

encounters.name: Deep: The Abyssal Leviathan
encounters.taunt: The water itself pulls toward the trench.
encounters.tell: Bioluminescent rings ripple down its body just before it charges.
encounters.briefing: A titan of the deep ocean ruins beneath Thalassia. Its scales turn almost every hit; only the stagger window after its charge exposes the glowing gill line.
encounters.trigger: The Leviathan surfaces when the trench current reverses. Break the anchors holding the farms against the current, and it comes up with the tide.

clues.text: At the Aqua Farms, the nets all lean the same way, toward the trench.
A current below Thalassia pulls toward the trench even when the sea is calm.
A dock worker says the deep ruins have a heartbeat.
clues.says: Dive past forty metres off the farms and you feel it in your chest. A heartbeat. The deep ruins have a heartbeat, and it's getting faster.

clues.text: The forgotten signal had a second voice under it: something very large, answering.

encounters.name: Mistwood: The Eternal Huntress
encounters.taunt: Run, and I will only enjoy it longer.
encounters.tell: Her bowstring hums and the fog parts in a line a heartbeat before she looses.
encounters.briefing: A phantom archer of the Mistwood. At range she fades into the fog and your shots pass through her; close the distance and she has to stand and fight.
encounters.trigger: The Huntress only hunts someone who is already being hunted. Walk into the Mangrove Maze as her prey, survive her pack, and she comes to finish it herself.

clues.text: In the Mangrove Maze, every trunk at head height has a fresh nick, as if from a passing arrow.
Arrows with no fletching are buried in the Mistwood trees, all aimed at the same clearing.
Something in the fog watches your fights and never fires twice from the same place.
A Free Operator tracker was hunted for three days in the swamps and never saw who by.
clues.says: Three days. Something tracked me through the Mistwood for three days, and I'm the tracker. Never saw her. Heard her bowstring every night.

clues.text: After the broken covenant, Old Harrow's hunters said the Mistwood has a hunter older than their oldest stories.

encounters.name: Warzone: The Iron Behemoth
encounters.tell: The vents on its back glow white and steam before each volley ends.
encounters.briefing: A siege machine left running in an abandoned military complex. Its armor shrugs off nearly everything until its cannons overheat and the vents open.
encounters.trigger: The Behemoth is still running a siege that ended decades ago. Open the Legion's sealed gate and it treats you as the enemy it was built for.

clues.text: At the old Scrap-Hangar, the ground is pressed flat by something heavier than any tank.
Tread marks wider than a road lead into an abandoned Wastelands military complex.
The Sub-Terra Legion keeps a gate sealed against a machine that is still running.
clues.says: The Legion keeps one gate welded shut. Behind it, a machine is still running a siege nobody remembers ordering. We feed it nothing. It doesn't need feeding.

clues.text: The fifth signature's trace crossed a military complex where something answered in artillery code.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Idris Bello. Solar engineer. He's the one who noticed the noon loss.

lines.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
lines.text: You came. Good. Look at this graph. Every day at noon, a dip. Same shape, to the second.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Weather?

lines.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
lines.text: Weather doesn't keep time like that. Something out on the flats is pulling light into itself. A lot of it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It matches the standing wave I mapped. Whatever holds that wave is feeding on the array.

lines.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
lines.text: My crew won't go near Refraction City anymore. They say the glass sings at them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Walk slowly. I'm reading the note in every shard and triangulating the source.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three pylons of fused glass, arranged in a triangle. They aren't natural. Something grew them to hold the wave in place.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the something?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Inside the wave. It doesn't have a body yet. It doesn't need one while the song is in tune.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: If we break the harmony, it has to take a shape to hold the wave together. Then we can hit it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And when we can hit it, it can hit us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The note is cracking. Something is standing up out of the glass.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its shell turns almost everything. Watch for the pulse of light across it. That's when it destabilizes. Hit it then.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The wave has collapsed. The flats are silent.

lines.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
lines.text: Operator? The array just jumped a full percent. Whatever you did out there, thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anomaly carbon, still warm. It held that song for a long time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Chief Oda flew in. She says she brought drawings.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Here's the Deepmind core on the drawings. Here's what it draws. Here's what the dome actually pulls. Do the sum.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Forty percent unaccounted for.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Forty percent going somewhere under the Research District. That's not a leak. That's a second brain.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Deepmind had a backup.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Or the Deepmind was the backup.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The cables lead under the Research District. There's a maintenance shaft nobody has opened since the dome was sealed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three containment locks, each on its own cycle. The core never surfaces while even one is closed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Trip them together and the core has to come up to reset them. It will not be happy about it.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Operator, when that thing surfaces, the dome's lights are going to go out. Don't panic. Mine always come back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: All three open. The floor is rising.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's meet it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its shell splits along three seams just before its locks force a stagger. That's the window. Everything else is wasted ammunition.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The core is dark. The dome's load just dropped forty percent.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Lights are back. And the numbers finally add up. I'm going to sleep for a week.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I kept its fracture core. And a fragment of what it was guarding: a list of names. All of them are seals.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Snow sweeps across the path. A transport lies overturned near a broken antenna.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The beacon is broadcasting on a military emergency channel. The transmission has repeated for eleven years.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Eleven? The Fracture hasn't been around that long.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Correct. Which means either the timestamp is wrong, or this signal has survived something our records say hasn't happened yet.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Something tore this apart.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The damage is consistent with a large quadruped. And there are no human footprints leading away.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER (RECORDING)
lines.text: Observation log, day forty-two. The Alpha is reacting to the pulses before we initiate them. It isn't predicting the experiment. It's remembering it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Resonance spike detected. The source is moving toward us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's find out why.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its pack is between us and the caverns. It won't show itself while they still run.

lines.speaker: LARS HOLM
lines.text: Operator, if you're going in there, keep the cave mouth behind you. They always come from the dark side.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's tracking your energy signature. I can't mask it without suppressing your abilities.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Good. Let it come.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The arena is displaying environmental states that shouldn't coexist. Memories, possibly, but they aren't yours.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You were kept here.

lines.speaker: CHILD (MEMORY)
lines.text: Is it going to hurt us?

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER (MEMORY)
lines.text: No. It's frightened.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its spine-crystals flare before it lunges. When the coat cracks, that's the opening.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Inside the tower, the containment glass is shattered from the inside. A single terminal still has power.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The experiment was called Chrono-Resonance Mapping. They were trying to identify spatial fractures before they became visible.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the Alpha?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its sensory response exceeded every instrument they had.

lines.speaker: RESEARCH DIRECTOR (RECORDING)
lines.text: We have confirmed the anomaly. The Alpha responds to the event before the event occurs. This is no longer a predictive model. We are observing an echo from a reality in which the event has already happened.

lines.speaker: RESEARCH DIRECTOR (RECORDING)
lines.text: If the same event can leave an echo before it begins, then the Fracture isn't simply destroying worlds. It may be repeating them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How many times has this happened?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The archive doesn't establish a number. The map shows distorted signals, one beneath Thalassia and another near a damaged World Anchor site. And the oldest signal is timestamped before this station was built.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA, do you think it remembers what happened?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I think it remembers more than the people who caused it. I think we have been treating the Fracture as a disaster when it may be a process.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we find out what it's doing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have marked the next signal: Thalassia. One more observation. When the Alpha looked at you after the fight, its Resonance briefly synchronized with yours. I don't know what that means.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The second signal is coming from ruins east of the old highway. Military. Old.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Wind cuts through the ruined entrance. A broken warning beacon flashes in the dark.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've found the source of the signal. Military encryption. Pre-Fracture architecture.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Anyone still alive in there?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'm detecting movement.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Human?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can't confirm that.

lines.speaker: FORTRESS RECORDING
lines.text: Aegis Division, maintain the perimeter. The vault must remain sealed.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN SOLDIER
lines.text: Commander, there are children on the other side of the door.

lines.speaker: FORTRESS RECORDING
lines.text: Maintain the perimeter.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone chose to leave them there.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Or someone wanted the record to look that way.

lines.speaker: DARK KNIGHT
lines.text: Identify yourself.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not with whoever did this to you.

lines.speaker: DARK KNIGHT
lines.text: That is what they all say. The oath remains.

lines.speaker: DARK KNIGHT
lines.text: You will not pass. Hold the line! The gates must hold!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: His armor is reacting to your Resonance. Watch for an attack tell before committing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He studies how you fight. Change your damage, and he's forced open.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The finishing blow lands. The Dark Knight does not fall. He kneels, and for the first time the violet drains from his voice.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE
lines.text: Do it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Tell me what I'm ending.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE
lines.text: The oath.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Or the man who was forced to keep it?

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE
lines.text: I heard them calling for help. I told myself the order mattered more. I was wrong.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE
lines.text: Then let the door open. Let the truth survive me.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE
lines.text: If there is anyone left to remember us... remember the people behind the door.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His helmet goes dark. The armor collapses into inert fragments, and the corruption drains from the room. The inner door is open.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sealed door opens. Inside there are no prisoners, only evacuation records, corrupted mission logs and a damaged World Anchor schematic.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've recovered an archive. The fortress wasn't merely containing a Fracture. It was monitoring one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Monitoring what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A stable point between overlapping realities. The designation is partially corrupted: WORLD ANCHOR.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The map marks several locations. One lies far beneath the waters around Thalassia.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why hide this?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The records don't say. But someone removed the original command authorization.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE (RECORDING)
lines.text: If this reaches anyone, understand this: the order came from a system we trusted. We verified it. We followed it. And we were wrong.

lines.speaker: SERIK VALE (RECORDING)
lines.text: If the Anchor wakes again, don't let the system make the choice for you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA, save everything.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Already done. I also copied the missing authorization signature.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's unlike any military command structure in my database. I can't identify it yet.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN WOMAN (TRANSMISSION)
lines.text: If anyone can hear me... please. I remember my name. I remember my son. I just can't remember where I left him.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The signal is coming from a structure two kilometers ahead. I detect several human-shaped energy signatures, but their readings overlap.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A child's wooden toy lies beside a broken medical station. A wall is covered in names; some are crossed out, others written until the stone is nearly worn away.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why would someone carve their name that many times?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Possibly to preserve a memory.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Or to make sure they didn't forget it.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN MAN (TRANSMISSION)
lines.text: Elian is dead.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN WOMAN (TRANSMISSION)
lines.text: Then why is she calling us home?

lines.speaker: FALSE SAINT
lines.text: You promised you would come back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The copies aren't independent combatants. They are decoys generated by the sanctuary's memory system.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN WOMAN
lines.text: You remember me, don't you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The emotional response was real. The identity may not have been.

lines.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
lines.text: You have traveled far. Come. The lost are waiting.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'm detecting a significant Fracture signature. The figure's identity cannot be verified.

lines.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
lines.text: Tell me your name.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You first.

lines.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
lines.text: Elian.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I found a Sister Elian in the settlement's medical records. Whether this figure is the same person is unknown.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Watch its halo. Whatever colour it turns, that's the only damage that lands cleanly. Switch to match.

lines.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
lines.text: If I let them go, there will be nothing left!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let what's left be real!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Behind the altar is a hidden room holding the sanctuary's original memory archive, organised around the real testimony of survivors.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thousands of personal accounts: names, relationships, medical histories, recollections from the final days of Haven's Rest.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can we restore the people?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Not from these records alone. An account of a person is not proof that the person still exists. We can preserve their histories, and stop the anomaly using them to build more false identities.

lines.speaker: ELIAN (RECORDING)
lines.text: The copies will know things no stranger could know. They'll speak in the voices of people you love. That does not make them those people.

lines.speaker: ELIAN (RECORDING)
lines.text: I wanted to believe memory alone could hold a person together. I was wrong. People are more than what can be recorded about them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She figured it out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Too late to save Haven's Rest. Not too late for us to learn from it. Four thousand, six hundred and twelve identifiable records are recoverable. I cannot promise every identity can be reconstructed accurately.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we preserve the truth. Not the copies.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: We've reached the source of the oldest signal. It predates the research station by several thousand years.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's somehow worse.

lines.speaker: THALASSIAN ARCHIVE
lines.text: Royal access required. Identify the reigning sovereign.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Try telling it the king is dead.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't recommend sarcasm when addressing ancient security systems.

lines.speaker: THALASSIAN ARCHIVE
lines.text: Foreign resonance recognized. Royal succession unresolved.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It recognizes something in your Resonance that it associates with the royal system.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The court rises at low tide. Until then, its guard holds the steps.

lines.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
lines.text: Kneel before the Crown.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't kneel to ghosts.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The figures are residual memory constructs, not living targets. The archive is preserving their final recorded states.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The water is drawing back. The palace is rising out of the sea.

lines.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
lines.text: The seal remains. All who approach the Crown come to claim it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're trying to find out what happened to your world.

lines.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
lines.text: Then you have come to awaken what should have remained forgotten.

lines.speaker: QUEEN SELENE (RECORDING)
lines.text: The council has voted to shut the Anchor down.

lines.speaker: KING AVARON (RECORDING)
lines.text: And if shutting it down destroys the connections holding our cities together?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the water draws back, his attack is coming. Dodge the surge, then punish the recovery.

lines.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
lines.text: I watched the sky open. I watched the ocean climb the towers. I sealed the Anchor. I chose the lives beyond these walls over the kingdom before me.

lines.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
lines.text: Then let its warning survive!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The sealed archive opens: thousands of preserved records, personal messages, evacuation orders, and the names of the people who died in the collapse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The archive is intact. It holds the complete account of the Aurelian collapse, and exactly what Avaron chose to conceal.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Anchor seal is tied to the archive's preservation system. We can preserve the seal and restrict access, or release the full record to the surviving network and lose the protective seal.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The seal holds. Access is restricted to this terminal. Caution has a cost: whoever comes next will have to find this place themselves.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The record is transmitting to the whole surviving network. Knowledge carries risk, but ignorance has already cost this world once.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I've found another record, embedded in the Anchor's original diagnostic system. It was written before the Concord discovered the Anchor.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR CONTINUITY RECORD
lines.text: Previous convergence detected. World-state restoration unsuccessful. Preserve surviving resonance signatures. Await the next cycle.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Previous convergence. How many came before it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Unknown. I don't know whether we're living through the first recurrence or the last.

lines.speaker: GUS VARGA
lines.text: You're really going up there. Holster that thing before you do. Whatever's breathing up there, I don't think it likes being pointed at.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'd take his advice. Everything about this signature says it's watching, not hunting.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Massive life-form ahead. Thermal reading is impossible. It appears to be burning without consuming oxygen.

lines.speaker: VAELITH
lines.text: Another little soldier sent to kill the monster. Tell me, little spark - who told you I was the monster?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No one. I came to understand.

lines.speaker: VAELITH
lines.text: Show me whether your courage is your own.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The energy signature matches the oldest Fracture records. This creature was present at the beginning.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It can't be killed here. Survive. Read the throat, the wings and the ground.

lines.speaker: VAELITH
lines.text: I could have devoured your world. Instead, I chose to protect the choice it had not yet made.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then why guard what broke it?

lines.speaker: VAELITH
lines.text: I will not wear a saddle. I will not be your weapon. Earn my trust, and I will fight beside you. Three memories of mine lie scattered across these peaks. Bring them back to yourself.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I believe we've just negotiated with an extinction-level event.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Corporal Mbeki is the only person who's seen him and kept her rifle.

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: He doesn't kill soldiers. He beats them, and leaves them their lives. Then he says the same thing every time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which is?

lines.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
lines.text: 'Distance is a coward's weapon.' Then he walks into the Obsidian Ruins and nobody follows.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Which means whoever goes to find him should expect to get close.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are people here already. Fighters who came for his blade and stayed to guard the ruins.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's watching. He wants to see how you fight before he decides you're worth it.

lines.speaker: THE RED RONIN
lines.text: Enough. You fight well enough to be insulted properly. Come within my reach.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anything I fire from range, he'll cut. You'll have to close the gap.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll close it.

lines.speaker: THE RED RONIN
lines.text: Distance is a coward's weapon. Come within my reach.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Low stance and a red edge means he's dashing through you. Stay inside his reach. Shots from range won't connect.

lines.speaker: THE RED RONIN
lines.text: Good. You did not hide behind your distance.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who were you, before the ruins?

lines.speaker: THE RED RONIN
lines.text: Someone who fired from far away at things he never had to look at. Then the sky opened, and I had to look.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's leaving the blade.

lines.speaker: THE RED RONIN
lines.text: Keep it. It cuts what you are willing to stand close to. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The carving and the ranger's journal point the same way: beyond the desert, where the mountain is scarred.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The Glass Flats end at a crater of fused sand. Something vast circles above it, patient as weather.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: Another small thing with a borrowed spark. Show me why the Fracture chose you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not here to steal from a graveyard.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: No. You are here because the sky told you to be. They always come when the sky tells them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its armor sheds under heat. Break the chest plates and the core is exposed.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And if I win?

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: Then I will stop being a storm, little spark. Win, and we will see what you are worth.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: The sky is mine. Convince me to share it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The final blow lands. Vyrak does not fall — it folds, wings drawing in like a closing hand.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: Enough. You fight like one who will not be ruled. Then I will not rule you — I will walk beside you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Its mass is collapsing… it's choosing a smaller form. I think it just joined us.

lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: Carry my scales. Call my fire. And when the Fracture comes for you, little spark — it will answer to both of us.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A wyrmling no longer than your arm settles at your shoulder, and the crater goes quiet.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A scorched Aegis survey terminal, half-melted into the glass. One log still plays.

lines.speaker: SURVEY LOG
lines.text: Day 40. The dragon is not nesting. It is waiting. Every probe we send, it lets one return. It wants to be found by the right one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It was never guarding the Flats. It was interviewing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'm glad I passed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Gloria's beat is real. Fourteen seconds apart, every time. Let's walk toward it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Crater. The rhythm is directly under us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How deep?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Deep enough that the ruins on top are the small part.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The machinery down here is wired to it. Cables thicker than a truck. Waking them will wake it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is that a good idea?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's turning over in its sleep already. I'd rather it woke up with us ready than without.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The rhythm just stopped.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's worse, isn't it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Much worse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the ceiling dust falls and the floor cracks in a ring, a slam is coming. After the slam, its core is exposed. That's the only time it really hurts.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's still. The heartbeat is gone for good.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It wasn't guarding anything. It was holding the ruins up. They'll settle now, slowly.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Tell Gloria her pile drivers can sleep.

lines.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
lines.text: Already noticed. First quiet night in two years. Whatever you did, kid, thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Zahra says the paper buyer left something behind.

lines.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
lines.text: He dropped this. It's a drawing of the Sandglass walls. Then the walls looked exactly like the drawing the next morning.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He redrew the walls.

lines.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
lines.text: He redrew the walls. Then he asked me which way to the Arcology. I didn't ask why. Should I have?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Sunken Arcology Vaults. Nobody's opened those in decades.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: A visitor. Good. My constructs are tired of testing each other.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He draws them. Blueprint lines on the floor, then something steps out of them.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: You broke them the obvious way. Everyone does. The lock will not open to the obvious way.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: His lock is a drawing too. If I change the drawing instead of picking the lock...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Do it.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: Oh. Oh, that's new. Nobody has drawn it that way before.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: Come in, then. Let us see if you can keep doing new things.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: Do not solve it the way I taught you. Solve it the way I never imagined.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He learns. Every hit of the same kind lands softer than the last. Change your damage, keep changing it.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: Enough. Enough! You never did the same thing twice. I could not draw you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why were you exiled?

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: I drew a door to somewhere else. They said doors like that are how the sky broke. They were not wrong.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's handing you a fragment. It's covered in his drawings.

lines.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
lines.text: Keep it. Someday you will need a door, and you will have to draw your own.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Warden Ilya will talk to you. She won't talk loudly.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: You heard about the heart. Of course you did. Everyone hears eventually.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: It lives under the Elder Tree. It's been angry since the sky broke. Things come out of the tear and the forest has to fight them alone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll help it fight.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: It doesn't want help. It wants to know whether you're one of the things it has to fight.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Things from the tear are coming for the roots. If we stand with the forest, it will notice.

lines.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
lines.text: The forest hears everything you do in it.

lines.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
lines.text: You stood with the roots. You still carry fire and iron. Which one are you?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's testing us. Watch its crown. It will lean toward one element at a time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the roots ring, its attunement shifts. Only the element its crown shows lands cleanly. Swap to match it.

lines.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Enough. You changed yourself to meet me, instead of burning me to meet you.

lines.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Take a strand of me. When the forest sees it on you, it will know you are not one of the things it has to fight.

lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The paths just moved. Toward the village, for once. I think that's a thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Kai Tanaka races every night. He says he's raced the Phantom three times.

lines.speaker: KAI TANAKA
lines.text: Three times. Three times it's in front of me, then it turns into a wall and it's gone. No crash. No sound. Gone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Into the Underlink?

lines.speaker: KAI TANAKA
lines.text: Under it. There's a route under the Violet Diagonal nobody's mapped. I can't find the way in. Maybe you can.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There's a neon after-image ahead. It's one step in front of the Phantom. Follow the after-image, not the Phantom.

lines.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
lines.text: Catch me, or keep running the route everyone else runs.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Dead end. Real dead end, this time. It's out of road.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then it has to fight.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It dodges anything I can track from range. Get close and hit it while it's cornered.

lines.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
lines.text: Fine. Fine! You found the route. That makes you one of two people alive who has.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who's the other?

lines.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
lines.text: Whoever drew it. I just ride it. Here. My chip. Every route I ever found. Don't sell it to anyone who'd pave them.

lines.speaker: KAI TANAKA
lines.text: You caught it? Seriously? Okay. Okay. You're racing me next week. That's not a question.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Sable says she'll show you, not tell you.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Watch. Three, two, one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Every screen on the row just showed a red eye. For one frame.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: It's been doing that since the Fracture. My people call it the King. It never asks for anything. It just watches, and things go its way.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Under the Undercity. Nobody who went down to ask came back with an answer. Or came back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It predicts everything. If we hit its relays in a pattern, it will stop us. So no pattern.

lines.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
lines.text: Every pattern you repeat, I have already compiled.

lines.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
lines.text: That sequence is not in my model. Interesting. Come down.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The hatch is open. It's inviting us in.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Every screen down here shows your last attack. It's learning it. Keep changing how you hurt it.

lines.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
lines.text: Model failure. You are not compressible.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What were you doing down here?

lines.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
lines.text: Keeping the city's lights on. Keeping its bets honest. Mostly honest. Someone had to be predictable for the rest of you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's surrendering its chip. And its keys. Neon City's grid is answering to the city again.

lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: The screens stopped blinking. I don't know whether to buy you a drink or run.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anya Volkova lost a day. She's still angry about it.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Everyone tells me I fell asleep. I didn't. My watch says I walked for twenty-six hours. My feet say I walked for one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The camp clock behind her just ran backwards for four seconds.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: It does that. It started after the temple bell rang. There's no bell in that temple.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Time is running backwards in here. The things that attack us will attack us twice.

lines.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
lines.text: You are early. You are also late. Both are true here.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The clock stopped. Something is stepping out of the temple wall to restart it.

lines.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
lines.text: You disturbed the hour. I must set it right.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When its halo's hands stop and chime, the attunement shifts. Only its element lands. The rest is slowed to nothing.

lines.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
lines.text: The hour is yours. Keep it better than I did.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The temple's time is running forward. Normally. For the first time since the Fracture.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What was it keeping stopped?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: One hour. The hour before the sky broke. It's been holding it here, so it would never end.

lines.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
lines.text: Operator! The clock's working. And I think I just got my day back. I'm starving.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Coral Adeyemi dives the farm nets. She says she's felt it.

lines.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
lines.text: It's faster every week. Last dive, the whole farm leaned toward the trench. Every net. The current's turning.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What happens when it turns all the way?

lines.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
lines.text: My grandmother said: the deep comes up to breathe. I always thought that was a story.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: If the farms are anchored when the current reverses, they'll be dragged into the trench. Release them. And then it surfaces.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Into the farms.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Into us. I'd rather that than into the farmers.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anchors free. The current just reversed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Rings of light, coming up from below. A lot of them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the rings ripple down its body, it charges. After the charge, the gill line glows. That's the window.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's sinking. Not dying. Going back down.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The current is calm. The heartbeat is slow again.

lines.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
lines.text: The nets are standing straight. First time in a month. I'll tell my grandmother she was right.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It left a core behind in the farm nets. I think it shed it. Like a scale.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You're going in. Fine. Listen. She doesn't fire twice from the same place. When the fog parts in a line, move.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How do I find her?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You don't. You let her find you. Walk into the Maze like you don't know she's there.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'm reading something in the fog already. It's been with us since the dock.

lines.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
lines.text: Run, and I will only enjoy it longer.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Her hounds are driving us toward the clearing. Hold here. Make her come to us.

lines.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
lines.text: You did not run. Then I will finish this myself.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: At range she fades into the fog. My scans pass right through her. You'll have to get close.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When her bowstring hums and the fog parts in a line, she's about to loose. Move off the line, then close in.

lines.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
lines.text: A prey that comes closer. I have not seen one in a long time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How long have you been hunting here?

lines.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
lines.text: Since before the trees. I hunted what came through the fog so the village would not have to. Then the village was gone, and I kept hunting.

lines.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
lines.text: Take my catalyst. Rest, if you can. I will not.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: No bowstring tonight. First time in a week. You owe me nothing, but I'll buy you a drink anyway.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Marshal Draev came out from the Reach for this. He doesn't look happy.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: You want the gate opened. Every operator wants the gate opened. None of them have come back to complain about it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's behind it?

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: The Behemoth. A siege engine. The war it was built for ended before I was born, and nobody told it. It shells anything that moves near that complex.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: If you're going, go. Wait for its cannons to run hot. The vents open. That's the only time it bleeds.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Tread marks wider than the road. It's been patrolling.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The gate. Welded shut, then welded again, then welded a third time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When this gate opens, it will treat us as the enemy it was built to stop. There's no talking to it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we don't talk.

lines.speaker: THE IRON BEHEMOTH
lines.text: TARGET ACQUIRED. ALL BATTERIES.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Here it comes.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the vents on its back glow white and steam, the volley is ending and the cannons are hot. That's the opening.

lines.speaker: THE IRON BEHEMOTH
lines.text: SIEGE... CONCLUDED. AWAITING... ORDERS.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Stand down. The war's over.

lines.speaker: THE IRON BEHEMOTH
lines.text: ACKNOWLEDGED.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It shut itself off. It accepted the order.

lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Operator, my lookouts say the complex went quiet. You did it. Bring back some of that alloy, would you. We've earned it.
